items.change: Added manual beta/latest publish-tag selection and passed the selected tag to npm publish.
items.responds_to: Publishing the Prisma 7-compatible package as a beta release.

items.change: Changed the documented client generator provider from prisma-client-js to prisma-client.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7's replacement of the prisma-client-js generator.

items.change: Added a version-compatibility section stating that package 4.x targets Prisma 7 and package 3.x and earlier target Prisma 6.
items.responds_to: The Prisma 7 peer-dependency and generator transition.

items.change: Documented installing the beta package together with Prisma 7 and added a Prisma 7 support notice.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7 support being released through the beta package.

items.change: Changed the test client generator provider from prisma-client-js to prisma-client.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7's replacement of the prisma-client-js generator.

items.change: Removed empty datasource url settings from the test schemas.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7's datasource configuration change that no longer accepts the schema url setting in these test configurations.

items.change: Updated generated-client test imports from target/index to target/client, and moved several generated input-type imports to target/pjtg or model files.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7's new prisma-client output layout and split generated declaration files.

items.change: Added Prisma-prefixed StringFieldUpdateOperationsInput and NullableStringFieldUpdateOperationsInput signatures to the transformation logic and added UpdateInput coverage.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7 qualifying update-operation types with the Prisma. namespace.

items.change: Added transformation support and tests for Int and Float field annotations, including nullable fields, scalar filters, update operations, and numeric arrays.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7 generated numeric field, filter, and update-input signatures.

items.change: Added handling and tests for Prisma-prefixed StringNullableListFilter signatures and String[] model, create-input, and update-input types.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7 qualifying generated list types with the Prisma. namespace.

items.change: Normalized signatures by stripping a leading Prisma. namespace and runtime. qualifiers before matching, replacing the duplicated qualified and unqualified cases.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7 generated declarations introducing Prisma. and runtime. qualified type names.

items.change: Generated capitalized aggregate and groupBy output-type candidates while preserving original model casing for input types, and added lowercase-model groupBy tests.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7 capitalizing output type names for lowercase Prisma model names.

items.change: Preserved the Prisma. namespace when generating NullableJsonNullValueInput unions and added extension-client coverage.
